skinname-blitzy:
{{name}}
The display name of the Blitzy skin. Appears in the skin chooser on [[Special:Preferences]] and in the site information returned by the action API.
blitzy-specialversion-name: {{name}} The skin name shown in the installed-skins credits table on [[Special:Version]]. Declared as the skin's namemsg in skin.json.
blitzy.css: {{optional}} Default content of [[MediaWiki:Blitzy.css]] and of each user's personal blitzy.css subpage, the stylesheets that load only for readers who are using the Blitzy skin. The value is a CSS comment describing what the page is for, and a wiki replaces it as soon as it adds real styles.
blitzy.js: {{optional}} Default content of [[MediaWiki:Blitzy.js]] and of each user's personal blitzy.js subpage, the scripts that load only for readers who are using the Blitzy skin. The value is a JavaScript comment describing what the page is for, and a wiki replaces it as soon as it adds real code.
blitzy-jumptocontent: Text of the skip link that comes first in the page body and jumps past the site chrome straight to the start of the article content. It stays visually hidden until it takes keyboard focus, so for most readers it is only ever announced by assistive technology: treat it as an accessible name and keep it descriptive rather than shortening it to a bare verb. This message takes no parameters.
blitzy-announcement-dismiss: Accessible name of the control that closes the announcement bar shown above the navigation card. The dismissal is remembered in the reader's own browser, so the bar stays closed on later page loads. The wording of the announcement and the label of its action button both come from the wiki's site configuration and are no part of this message, so this message takes no parameters and no placeholder may be introduced into it.
